description: Grants the isolated rebuilt library shell's window (label `library`, spec 064) the core defaults plus the native open and save pickers and the path opener for its webview. The planning handlers reach the dialog and opener plugins through their Rust APIs, which need no grant. `default.json` names only the legacy windows, so its message dialogs, unscoped reveal, window and webview control, updater and process grants never reach this window.
